title: Pure bending through a distributing coupling
source: Euler–Bernoulli pure bending, σ = M_y z/I, θ = ML/(EI) (exact in elasticity for ν = 0); Timoshenko and Goodier, Theory of Elasticity, 3rd ed., 1970, §102

quantities.quantity: bending stress σ_xx at mid-span, top fibre (10, 0.5, 1)
quantities.reason: with ν = 0 pure bending is a quadratic displacement field that hex20 represents exactly; the coupling's nodal forces are the consistent loads of the linear traction, so the field is exact to the end face; the probe is five depths from it (Saint-Venant)

quantities.quantity: rotation of the reference point about y
quantities.reason: the reference point follows the best-fit rigid motion of the end section, and the coupling's nodal forces are the consistent loads of the linear traction, so the field is exact to the end face
